items.title: Sign and return offer letter to accept
items.quote: To accept, please sign the enclosed offer letter and return it to People Operations no later than March 26, 2025.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date by which the signed offer must be returned: March 26, 2025. This is a fixed date set by the sender (a private US company, not a German authority), so no statutory delivery-fiction or BGB period-counting rules apply; the date is taken as printed. No weekend/holiday adjustment is needed or stated by the letter.
